title: Future Trunks Deserves a Bigger Role in Dragon Ball’s Anime Future
content:
Before the Marvel Cinematic Universe became a trend, Dragon Ball Z became one of the forefathers of expanded universes, giving its fans the OG time traveling hero , Future Trunks. The introduction to him came just a few episodes after the Frieza saga and hadn’t revealed the full picture of Vegeta and Bulma’s relation to him. The young Saiyan warrior quickly makes his presence known by taking down two of the most-feared aliens in the world with ease.

Future Trunks shreds Frieza and then blows up King Cold without breaking much of a sweat. A task that seemed insane considering how difficult Frieza was to defeat for Goku just a few episodes earlier. However, the blend of his parents is obvious. He’s revealed to be a more compassionate character like his mother, as noted by his care for the future of the planet but also is a confident but not nearly as cocky fighter like Vegeta. This blend made for a great protagonist and Dragon Ball Z ‘s own version of The Terminator franchise’s Kyle Reese. He just needs to be around way more.

Alternate Timeline Trunks Disappears With No Trace

Future Trunks and the Z Fighters trained up for the challenge at hand, and although Cell proved a worthy opponent, they eventually triumphed. As quickly as this powerful, futuristic friend came into the picture, he left and didn’t return for nearly a quarter century. A disappointing turn of events for a character that had become beloved by lots of fans. His development and work with Vegeta helped shape his father into the person he’s become in the current timeline.

Furthermore, Future Trunks’ exploits in the battlefield likely would’ve come in handy against some of the foes they face. Still, creator Akira Toriyama didn’t sideline the character forever. As is the way lots of times with Dragon Ball , a nostalgic part of history is destined to return. Future Trunks returns in the non-canon film, Broly – The Legendary Super Saiyan and helps the team of Saiyans defeat the manical Broly . He then made his canon return almost a quarter century later in Dragon Ball Super .

His character didn’t change much over the course of that time. He’s still just as serious and concerned for the future of the world as he was originally in the Cell Saga. He got to witness the death and destruction that Goku Black caused as well. He’s quite the traumatized man, but his resiliency is also what makes him a great character. Future Trunks is almost the pessimistic version of Goku in a lot of ways. Goku is the impossible optimist, but always looking to improve. Whereas Trunks looks for the bleak in situations and trains out of a fear of failure.

Future Trunks finally gets the peaceful, happy ending he deserved for so long, and he gets to deal the winning blow in the fight against Zamasu. He splits fused Zamasu right down the middle to end the physical threat of the monster. While winning the fight, Trunks states that they won’t let him win, which is a moment where he finally seems to see an encouraging light at the end of the tunnel. Although his life is now at peace and not in constant war, everyone knows the Z Fighters don’t laze around waiting for the next fight. Furthermore, Future Trunks went from a tragic tale and turned into a positive one. His story deserves to continue getting told.

What Does The Future Hold For Future Trunks?

The character is clearly not going anywhere. He came back in the non-canon Super Dragon Ball Heroes as Xeno Trunks, but much like the non-canon appearance in the Broly film, it doesn’t mean his story is continuing in the real timeline. However, these small fan service moments mean they’re going to keep him in the public’s consciousness.

His storyline didn’t receive the overall feelgood ending that the rest of the real timeline got, but it’s a gritty story that feels more like real life. It took a long time for Future Trunks to achieve a life that wasn’t wrought with death, so it should get a deeper run. What do you think? Should Future Trunks continue to get more storylines in other series? Let us know in the comments.

title: Firefly Wedding TV Anime Casts Natsuko Abe
content:
The official X/Twitter account for the television anime of Oreko Tachibana 's Firefly Wedding manga revealed on Thursday that the series has cast Natsuko Abe as Aoi, Satoko's mentor and a courtesan with a gentle demeanor:

The anime stars Lynn as Satoko Kirigaya and Kōki Uchiyama as Shinpei Gotō. Additional cast members include Kent Itō as Kōtarō Ogawa and Kenjirō Tsuda as Mitsueda.

Takahiro Kamei (2022-2024's Urusei Yatsura ) is directing the anime at david production , and Yukiko Aikei ( Horizon in the Middle of Nowhere , Words Bubble Up Like Soda Pop , Your Lie in April ) is designing the characters. Yūko Kakihara (2022-2024 Urusei Yatsura series, IRODUKU: The World in Colors , Blue Box ) is overseeing and writing the series scripts, and NOGRID is composing the music.

Iri performs the opening theme song "Period," and TOOBOE performs the anime's ending theme song "Yumegokochi" (Trance).

Viz Media publishes the manga in English, and it describes the story:

On the surface, Satoko has it all—she's beautiful, the daughter of a nobleman, and at a prime age for marriage. Unfortunately, she is also quite ill and only has a short time left to live. Before she can secure a marriage that will redeem her worth in her family's eyes, she finds herself the target of the mysterious assassin Shinpei, and her plans are put in jeopardy. In order to save herself, she makes a desperate proposal—of marriage! When it comes to love, however, Shinpei takes “until death do we part” seriously.

Tachibana launched the manga on Shogakukan 's Manga ONE app in January 2023, and Shogakukan published the 13th compiled book volume on October 19.

The manga is also inspiring a live-action television adaptation that is slated to debut in 2027.

title: The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster Game's Trailer Reveals May 13 Release in West
content:
NIS America announced on Thursday that it will release The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster ( Shinigami Hime to Ishokan no Kaibutsu ) game in the West for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam on May 13, 2027. The company unveiled a release date announcement trailer:

The game launched on Switch, Switch 2, and PS5 in Japan on April 30.

The fantasy side-scrolling adventure game features a picture book aesthetic and storytelling style. The story centers on Mono (voiced by Rena Motomura ), the child of a family that runs an opera house. Mistreated and cast aside, she does chores for her family around the opera house, and lives in the attic, loved only by her beloved older sister ( Reina Kondo ), who teaches her of opera and dance. One day, her sister is infected with a virulent disease known as Paper Mortis (Shinigami-byō) that eventually turns all it infects into a picture book, and eventually into a horrific "paper monster." The disease seems to greatly affect teenage girls in particular. The state has given up on curing it, and instead confines patients into facilities known as Asylum Libraries, where they are allowed to waste away.

With her sister confined in one such facility, Mono sets out toward it, desperate to do the impossible: to find a way to reverse her sister's disease. Within the Asylum Library, she finds it overrun with paper monsters, and filled with strange warps in reality: manifestations of the picture books that patients have turned into, expanded into a bizarre realm that contains their memories and traumas. Mono encounters a legendary paper monster named Mär ( Makoto Koichi ), with whom Mono forges an uneasy alliance. Mär is keen on exacting revenge against the human race for a past grievance, but will protect Mono as she navigates the Asylum Library and the picture book worlds in search of her sister.

Kento Jobana ( Phantom Brave: The Lost Hero , Disgaea 7 ) directed and wrote the game. Illustrator Sayaka Oda ( The Cruel King and the Great Hero , The Liar Princess and the Blind Prince ) was the character designer and illustrator for the game. Takeshi Matsumoto ( The Cruel King and the Great Hero , The Liar Princess and the Blind Prince ) composed the music for the game. Akiko Shikata , known for her work in the Ar Tonelico series, performs the game's theme song. Shikata also performed songs for The Cruel King and the Great Hero and The Liar Princess and the Blind Prince .

title: Naruto’s Most Exciting Battle Against Madara Is Getting a New U.S. Release
content:
Naruto Shippuden is all set to release Blu-ray Set 12 this November, as confirmed by the official website of Viz Media . Based on Masashi Kishimoto’s iconic Weekly Shonen Jump manga, the anime is just as popular even now thanks to its exceptional storytelling, unique power system, and deeply complex characters. The manga began its weekly serialization in 1999, and not long after that, Studio Pierrot’s anime adaptation in 2002 turned it into a global phenomenon. While the original anime aired until 2007, the animation studio released a second part called Naruto: Shippuden , following the beloved characters after a two-and-a-half-year time skip.

Just like the previous releases, we can expect the set to include four Blu-ray discs and the uncut version of 28 Episodes. The website also confirms this new set will include Episodes 305 to 332, which were originally broadcast in Japan in 2013. Not only that, but the Blu-ray DVDs will also be available in English dub, while the Japanese dub contains English subtitles. Additionally, just like the previous sets, this upcoming one will also have a few bonuses for fans , including an art card, storyboards, and much more. Viz Media has also confirmed more releases in the next few months and in 2027 to release the full series in batches of 28 episodes.

What Happened in Naruto Shippuden ‘s Final War?

Episodes 305 to 332 feature the Fourth Great Shinobi War when the Allied Forces joined hands against Madara Uchiha and his army of White Zetsu and the Reanimated Shinobi. At this point in the story, Naruto Uzumaki was still on a remote island, unaware of the wide-scale war happening in the world. As the host of the Nine-Tails, it was imperative to ensure Naruto wouldn’t fall into the hands of the enemies. Meanwhile, Madara fought against the entire Allied Shinobi Forces all by himself. Standing tall in front of 80,000 Shinobi soldiers and crushing them single-handedly is one of the biggest reasons why Madara is still an iconic Shonen villain . He displayed the true extent of his powers after waking up with Reanimation Jutsu, and it didn’t take him a lot of effort to stun everyone with his devastating abilities.

Naruto Is Taking the Stage During Jump Festa 2027

Naruto is planning major revival projects soon enough , including a live-action Hollywood movie, the manga sequel, and the anime’s return. Since the main story is already over, it’s possible that Studio Pierrot is planning to release a completely original story in the anime movie, which could be outside of everything that has happened in Boruto . Jump Festa 2027 is right around the corner since it’s scheduled to be held on December 19th and 20th, 2026. Jump Festa is famous for dropping the biggest updates on the upcoming projects of the most beloved Shonen Jump series. While there’s been no official confirmation as to what the announcements will be, we can expect the franchise to drop updates on the upcoming projects. Naruto will be holding a panel on the Super Stage , the largest stage in the entire convention, which is all the more reason to believe the announcements will be more exciting than ever.

title: FromSoftware Delays The Duskbloods Switch 2 Game to 2027
content:
The Duskbloods will launch exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2.

There was a Closed Network Test from August 21-23.

In the game, players control a Bloodsworn and fight enemies in the world using various weapons and abilities. Players can also form alliances.

FromSoftware released Elden Ring: Tarnished Edition , the Nintendo Switch 2 version of the Elden Ring game , physically and digitally worldwide on August 28. FromSoftware had delayed the game from 2025 to 2026 in order to work on the game's performance. The new version includes content from the DLC expansion Shadow of the Erdtree . The game also features new armor and a new customization for Torrent's appearance.

FromSoftware launched the original Elden Ring game for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and PC via Steam in February 2022.

title: 3 Coolest Mobile Suits from Gundam Wing After 30 Years
content:
The first and arguably most popular Gundam show for American audiences dropped a quarter century ago, and it featured some all-time mobile suits. Mobile Suit Gundam Wing was released through Toonami in 2000 and jettisoned Gundam right to the top of all mecha anime lists. Most kids probably didn’t understand the complex plot that featured double crosses, faction switches, and politics galore. But, we could understand giant robots with guns and beam sabers battling was a cool concept.

Before the list begins there are some ground rules to cover. First off, this list includes only Gundam suits that were introduced in the first series, not its Endless Waltz sequel. This means any remakes or customs that were added in are ineligible for this list. It’s an important distinction because that list is all its own, as all five main character Gundam were redesigned for the three-part series. Still, these three are the quintessential, universally-known Gundam from this series. So much so, there are still games and model kits featuring these three today, and it’s also why fans would love to see them with today’s technology in a new show .

3) Heavyarms Gundam

Who doesn’t love a gatling gun for an arm or machine guns and missile launchers mounted to hidden parts of a robot right? Heavyarms represents everything that’s cool about mecha. Those scenes where all compartments would open and let loose so much weaponry that the gundam was engulfed in gun smoke were the epitome of jaw-dropping. Heavyarms felt like a fan request come to life, just put machine guns everywhere and it’ll work.

It also added to the personality of the Heavyarms Gundam that Trowa Barton piloted it. His calm, cool and collected demeanor made a nice oppositional relationship to the loudest, most-aggressive gundam in the G Team fleet. This Gundam might’ve lacked the close-range abilities and ran out of ammo quick, but it could put in work in a short amount of time.

2) Tallgeese II

The final salvo of Treize Khushrenada resulted in a hulking, intimidating transformation into the Tallgeese II Gundam. After its initial build was destroyed, this Mobile Suit was rebuilt and became a striking hybrid of all-around attack. Tallgeese II utilized sabers, a shield and massive thrusters on its shoulders to engage in close-range combat. A terrifying combination because of its speed and power in hand-to-hand battles.

When it engaged in long-range combat, the Tallgeese II used a massive Dober Gun connected to its right arm. This weapon shredded through common mobile suits and could also damage Gundam suits. Its paint scheme and look were also vastly different from other Gundam in the franchise. It featured a unique head crest with Roman soldier inspiration and also red streaks below the eyes. Thrusters weren’t usually used, and also rarely do Gundam have such competent weaponry in all phases. Although this isn’t the final model of the Tallgeese, it’s the last upgrade for this series.

1) Epyon

There’s no chance the No. 1 Gundam from this show could be anything other than Epyon. A stark contrast to every other suit in the series, the Epyon featured a dark color scheme and original weapons that were memorable. The first thing that’s noticeable about this Gundam, similar to the Tallgeese II, is its intimidating size on screen headlined by its massive wings. Furthermore, the chain-like whip (called a Heat Rod) that extends out of the shield can’t be ignored. It gives the Epyon a significant advantage in close-range battles.

This suit isn’t loaded with long-range weapons, but it’s so fast and devastating in the short-range that it doesn’t matter. This was also a great move by the creators of the series, because it forced all the action in tight between the Mobile Suit opposite the Epyon. No need for gun fights with this suit. It wouldn’t allow it. Similar to the Wing Gundam, Epyon can also shift in flight mode and become a jet. It’s just such a cool Gundam, and it’s probably why Master Gundam in G Gundam was also so memorable for American audiences . The enemy just looked insurmountable with the size and strength of Epyon and Master. Do you agree with the list? Let us know in the comments.

This suit isn’t loaded with long-range weapons, but it’s so fast and devastating in the short-range that it doesn’t matter. This was also a great move by the creators of the series, because it forced all the action in tight between the Mobile Suit opposite the Epyon. No need for gun fights with this suit. It wouldn’t allow it. Similar to the Wing Gundam, Epyon can also shift in flight mode and become a jet. It’s just such a cool Gundam, and it’s probably why Master Gundam in G Gundam was also so memorable for American audiences . The enemy just looked insurmountable with the size and strength of Epyon and Master. Do you agree with the list? Let us know in the comments.

title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend Film Screens in U.S., Canada on February 21, 23-24
content:
Crunchyroll announced on Thursday that it and Sony Pictures Entertainment will screen the Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend ( Seishun Buta Yarō wa Dear Friend no Yume o Minai ) film, the latest anime of Hajime Kamoshida 's Rascal Does Not Dream (Seishun Buta Yarō or Aobuta) novel series, for three days only on February 21, 23, and 24 in the U.S. and Canada. The company streamed an English-subtitled trailer:

Fans who saw the film in the first week of release received a bonus new text story written by Kamoshida titled Seishun Buta Yarō wa Tea Garden no Yume o Miru (Rascal Does Dream of a Tea Garden). The short story follows Sakuta, Mai and Shoko after a shopping trip. Keeji Mizoguchi illustrated the short story.

The new film teases that it takes the story towards its finale. (The film shares the same name as the 15th and final novel volume.)

The film's returning cast includes:

• Kaito Ishikawa as Sakuta Azusagawa

• Asami Seto as Mai Sakurajima

• Sora Amamiya as Uzuki Hirokawa

• Aya Yamane as Ikumi Akagi

• Konomi Kohara as Sara Himeji

• Manaka Iwami as Miori Mitō

• Reina Ueda as Nene Iwamizawa

• Nao Tōyama as Tomoe Koga

• Atsumi Tanezaki as Rio Futaba

• Maaya Uchida as Nodoka Toyohama

• Yurika Kubo as Kaede Azusagawa

• Inori Minase as Shōko Makinohara

Sōichi Masui returned to direct the film at CloverWorks . Masahiro Yokotani was also back to oversee and write the script, and Satomi Tamura again designed the characters. The band fox capture plan also returned to compose the music. Aniplex is once again distributing the film.

Tōko Kirishima performs the song "Turn the World Upside Down" in the film and the theme song "Suihei-sen wa Boku no Furukizu finale" (The Horizon Is My Old Wound: Finale).

Rascal Does Not Dream of Bunny Girl Senpai ( Seishun Buta Yarō wa Bunny Girl-senpai no Yume wo Minai ), the first television anime based on the light novel series, premiered in Japan in October 2018 and aired for 13 episodes. The anime adapts the story up to the fifth novel volume. Aniplex of America streamed the series on Crunchyroll , Funimation , and other services.

Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dreaming Girl ( Seishun Buta Yarō wa Yume-Miru Shōjo no Yume wo Minai ), the anime film that adapts the the sixth and seventh light novel volumes in the franchise , opened in Japan in June 2019. Aniplex of America and Funimation Films screened the anime in the United States. Crunchyroll began streaming the film in June 2025 with both English subtitles and dub .

The film Rascal Does Not Dream of a Sister Venturing Out opened in Japan in June 2023. The film sold 118,108 tickets in its first three days and earned 175,648,924 yen (about US$1.28 million) to rank #4 in its opening weekend. The Rascal Does Not Dream of a Knapsack Kid film opened in Japan in December 2023, and ranked at #4 in its opening weekend. The film sold 119,000 tickets and earned 164,594,554 yen (about US$1.11 million) in its first three days.

Rascal Does Not Dream of Santa Claus ( Seishun Buta Yarō wa Santa Claus no Yume wo Minai ), the television anime adapting the light novel series' "University Student Arc," debuted in July 2025. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired, and is also streaming an English dub .

The original novel series has over 3 million copies in circulation. The Yen On imprint of Yen Press publishes the novel series, and Yen Press publishes Tsugumi Nanamiya 's manga adaptation. Yen On published the Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend novel volume on January 6.

title: Daily Report About My Witch Senpai Manga Ends
content:
Seven Seas Entertainment releases the manga, and it describes the story:

Misono is an office drone with his own ups and downs at work, but thankfully, he has an ally: his senpai Shizuka, who happens to be a witch. Shizuka is always ready to lend a hand to those in need, but Misono thinks she should take better care of herself, since zipping around on a broomstick to run errands can be quite stressful. Is Misono's over-solicitous concern for Shizuka driven by mere respect for this flustered witch, or could it be more? Let this magical romantic comedy cast its spell on you!

Mochida launched the manga in Manga Cross in August 2018. The manga's 42nd chapter launched in November 2020. Mochida then launched a sequel of the manga in April 2022, with the continuation listed as the 43rd chapter. Seven Seas released the manga's fifth volume in English in November 2025.

title: Lustful Domination Novels/Manga Get AnimeFesta Anime
content:
Suiseisha announced on Thursday that author Isotarо̄ shimano and manga artist Migi's Lustful Domination: My Magic and Virility Are So Strong, I Can Go At It 24/7 ( Shikiyoku Hadou ~Maryoku to Seiryoku Tsuyotsuyo na no de 24-Jikan Musou Shimasu~ ) novels and manga are getting an AnimeFesta anime.

shimano debuted the web novel on Nocturne in June 2025. Migi launched the manga adaptation in 2026. Suiseisha will publish the first compiled book volume on November 18.

WWWave Corporation 's Coolmic website is publishing the manga in English, and it describes the story:

The ultimate horndog in another world! My cheat skill turned out to be "baby-making." In a fantasy world where it's accepted as fact that men with high magical energy have no sex drive, I was reincarnated as an anomaly: a noble born with both immense magical energy and an insatiable libido. And if anyone finds out I actually do have sexual desires, I'll be banished on the spot! Terrified of losing everything and being separated from my beloved personal maid, Liese, I swear to keep myself under strict control. But when the time comes, an outrageous "official duty" waits for me. It's to be carried out in bed and involves having children with beautiful women! And then, to make matters worse, I catch sight of Liese herself, pleasuring herself on my very pillow...?! I'm at my limit. I can't hold back anymore. Now, the cheat skill I've hidden all this time is about to explode!!

WWWave Corporation owns the ComicFesta web manga service, as well as the AnimeFesta anime programming block. AnimeFesta (formerly Anime Zone and ComicFesta Anime ) has produced short anime adaptations of more than 30 manga from ComicFesta in the past eight years, with many of the manga being adult or risqué in nature. The first AnimeFesta anime was On a Lustful Night Mingling with a Priest ( Sōryo to Majiwaru Shikiyoku no Yoru ni... ), whose Japanese title has led to AnimeFesta anime sometimes being called "Sōryo-waku" (Sōryo-type) by fans. Most of the anime series have two different versions: a "broadcast" version (the censored version aired on television), and a "premium" uncensored version distributed online. WWWave Corporation releases many of the anime titles in English on its Coolmic website, and recently began releasing anime on OceanVeil .

title: Disney Twisted-Wonderland Season 2: Episode of Savanaclaw Reveals New Visual, December 23 Premiere
content:
Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation: Episode of Savanaclaw revealed a new visual, along with a December 23 premiere date. The anime will be streaming weekly exclusively on Disney+ (Disney Plus), with eight confirmed episodes.

Fairouz Ai has also joined the cast as Yuga Hirasaka. There are already 3 confirmed seasons for the anime, with the first already having covered Episode of Heartslabyul .

The anime will cover the first three manga adaptations, with each of the seasons sharing their names:

• Season 1: Episode of Heartslabyul

• Season 2: Episode of Savanaclaw

• Season 3: Episode of Octavinelle

The main staff for the anime includes:

• Director: Shin Katagai

• Chief Director: Takahiro Natori

• Script: Yoichi Kato

• Character Designers: Hanaka Nakano, Akane Sato

• Animation Studios: Yumeta Company, Graphinica

Episode of Heartslabyul was based on Alice of Wonderland , while Episode of Savanaclaw is based on The Lion King . You can see the new visual below.

The anime previously revealed a teaser trailer, which you can also watch below.

Yana Toboso, the original creator of the Black Butler manga series, is credited for the character design, concept, and scenario for the Disney Twisted-Wonderland game, which was created by Aniplex and Walt Disney Japan. The game was released in Japan on March 18, 2020, while the English localization followed on January 20, 2022.

The fourth manga adaptation covering the Episode of Scarabia released its first volume on February 27.
